🎥🎬: Mr. Irrelevant: The John Tuggle Story (2026)

The final pick of the NFL Draft is supposed to be the player nobody remembers. John Tuggle decides to make sure that isn’t his story.

After being selected last, Tuggle faces the enormous challenge of proving he belongs in a league filled with talented athletes. Every obstacle becomes another opportunity to silence the doubts surrounding him.

With determination and an unwillingness to quit, Tuggle begins turning an embarrassing nickname into a symbol of perseverance. His story shows that being overlooked can be the beginning of something extraordinary.

Release date: December 25, 2026
